competences.description: Attacks the enemy to deal damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken. The damage increases as your Attack Power is higher than the enemy's Defense.

Attacks the enemy 2 times to decrease its Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance each. Each hit's damage decreases if your Attack Power is higher than the enemy's Defense, but the number of hits increases up to 6 times.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
effets.note: Up to 4 if your attack power is higher than the enemy's defense

competences.description: At the start of every turn, if your HP did not increase compared to the previous turn and has decreased by less than 30% of your HP, it will revert to the HP condition from the previous turn. [Automatic Effect]
